lessons.title: Learning Nativity Songs
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to join in singing a simple Nativity song with actions.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a recording of the Nativity song.
lessons.main_activity: Practise singing the first Nativity performance song with actions, focusing on clear words and timing.
key_questions: What part of the song do you like?
Can you remember the actions?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note participation and confidence — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Perform the song once more together.
lessons.home_link: Practise singing the song at home.

lessons.title: Learning My Performance Lines
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say a simple line clearly for the performance.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult models saying a line clearly and with expression.
lessons.main_activity: Children practise their individual/group performance line (e.g. animal noise, simple sentence) with adult support.
key_questions: Can you say your line clearly?
How could you say it with more expression?

differentiation.support: Simplify line to a sound/single word
differentiation.extension: Add expression/character voice to the line

lessons.assessment_notes: Note speech clarity and confidence — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.home_link: Practise saying your line clearly at home.

lessons.title: Feeling Nervous About Performing
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name a strategy to help with performance nerves.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that feeling nervous before a performance is normal.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce simple strategies (deep breaths, thinking of a happy thought) for managing performance nerves.
key_questions: Do you feel nervous or excited?
What could help you feel calmer?

differentiation.support: Adult models one strategy to try

lessons.assessment_notes: Note emerging self-regulation strategies — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Practise a calming breath together before rehearsal.
lessons.home_link: Practise a calming breath together before the performance.

lessons.title: Making Costume Props
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct a simple costume prop for their role.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of simple Nativity costumes (halo, animal ears, star).
lessons.main_activity: Children make a simple costume prop for their performance role using craft materials.
key_questions: What is your prop for?
How did you make it?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative construction — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2.
lessons.home_link: Practise wearing your costume prop at home.

lessons.title: Listening for Cues
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to listen for their cue and respond at the right time.
lessons.starter_activity: Practise a simple call-and-response listening game.
lessons.main_activity: Rehearse the performance sequence, focusing on listening for cues (music, spoken line) before moving/speaking.
key_questions: What is your cue to move/speak?
How do you know when it's your turn?

differentiation.support: Adult gives a visual signal alongside the cue

lessons.assessment_notes: Note listening and timing skill — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Practise listening for a 'cue' word/sound at home.

lessons.title: Supporting Each Other in Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to encourage a friend during rehearsal.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how a kind word can help someone feel braver.
lessons.main_activity: During rehearsal, children practise giving simple encouragement to peers ('well done', 'you can do it').
key_questions: How did you encourage a friend today?
How did it feel to be encouraged?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note prosocial encouragement behaviour — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap kind words used during rehearsal.
lessons.home_link: Encourage a family member with kind words today.

lessons.title: Full Run-Through Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform their song/line/movement in sequence with the whole group.
lessons.starter_activity: Warm up voices and bodies together.
lessons.main_activity: Full run-through of the performance from start to finish, with adult support and encouragement throughout.
key_questions: What part are you most confident with?
What part needs more practice?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note overall performance confidence and sequence recall — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.home_link: Practise your part of the performance at home.

lessons.title: Talking About the Nativity Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain in a sentence what the performance is about.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the Nativity story from Week 13.
lessons.main_activity: Children practise explaining what their performance is about to a partner in a full sentence.
key_questions: What is your performance about?
Who is your character?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note explanatory sentence use — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.home_link: Explain what your performance is about to your family.

lessons.title: Feeling Proud of Our Progress
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express pride in how their performance has improved.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap how the performance has come together this week.
lessons.main_activity: Children reflect on and share what they feel proud of in their performance progress.
key_questions: What are you proud of?
What has got easier with practice?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective self-esteem language — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class round of 'I'm proud that...' statements.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family what you're proud of about your performance.

lessons.title: Dress Rehearsal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform in full costume with confidence.
lessons.starter_activity: Get into costume and warm up together.
lessons.main_activity: Full dress rehearsal of the performance in costume, with a small audience (another class) if possible for practice.
key_questions: How does it feel performing in costume?
What went well today?

differentiation.support: Adult provides reassurance and prompts as needed

lessons.assessment_notes: Note performance readiness and confidence — evidence for EAD.2/PSED.1.
lessons.home_link: Show family your costume before the big performance.

lessons.title: Following the Final Running Order
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to follow the full sequence of the performance from memory.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the running order using picture cues.
lessons.main_activity: Practise the performance sequence once more, focusing on remembering the order without prompts.
key_questions: What comes next in the performance?
Can you remember without looking?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note memory and sequencing recall — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Final recap of the full running order.
lessons.home_link: Talk through the performance order with family.

lessons.title: Calming Nerves Before the Big Day
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use a calming strategy independently before performing.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the calming breath strategy from Monday.
lessons.main_activity: Practise using the calming strategy independently as a group before the final rehearsal, discussing how it helps.
key_questions: How do you feel now?
Did the calming strategy help?

differentiation.extension: Child leads the strategy for the group

lessons.assessment_notes: Note independent use of self-regulation strategy — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap feeling ready and calm for the performance.
lessons.home_link: Practise the calming breath together before the performance day.

lessons.title: The Christmas Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform their song/line/role confidently in front of an audience.
lessons.starter_activity: Final warm-up of voices and bodies, and a calming breath together.
lessons.main_activity: The class performs the Nativity/Christmas performance for parents/carers or another audience.
key_questions: How did it feel to perform?
What was your favourite part?

differentiation.support: Adult provides reassurance and prompts as needed
differentiation.extension: Perform independently with full confidence and expression

lessons.assessment_notes: Note final performance confidence — evidence for EAD.2/CL.2/PSED.1, summarising progress across the week.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the completed performance with the whole class.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your performance with your family!

lessons.title: Reflecting on the Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how the performance went using full sentences.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the performance that just happened.
lessons.main_activity: Circle time reflection: children share how the performance felt and what they enjoyed most, using full sentences.
key_questions: How did the performance feel?
What was your favourite moment?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language use — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Class cheer celebrating a wonderful performance.
lessons.home_link: Share your favourite performance moment with your family again.

lessons.title: Celebrating Autumn Term Achievements
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on their achievements across the whole autumn term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key moments from across the whole autumn term (starting school, family week, helpers, festivals, performance).
lessons.main_activity: Children share their proudest moment or achievement from the whole term, contributing to a 'Look How Far We've Come' display.
resources_needed: Photos/work samples from across the term
key_questions: What are you most proud of from this term?
How have you grown since September?

differentiation.support: Point to a photo and share simply
differentiation.extension: Explain growth and achievement in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and term-long progress overview — evidence for PSED.1, summarising the whole of Autumn 1 and 2.
lessons.plenary: Whole-class celebration of a fantastic first term at school.
lessons.home_link: Share your proudest moment from this term with your family over the holidays.
